title: 第9章 虫身人心第10章 终至筑基天赐神通
content_zh:
“人类真是奇怪，明明自身难保，还在关心别人！”
茅不易心中虽然不解，但还是继续朝着深处挖去，直到感到安全为止。
夜幕降临，大泽依旧被白雾所笼罩。
没有月光、星光，整片大地一片漆黑，双眼看不到任何东西。
一只碧绿的蜣螂从土中钻出。
“嗯，都走了，可算安全了！”
“汪！汪！”
听到叫声，茅不易展开神识：
小黑还是如白日一般躺在血泊之中。
只是身边的鲜血已然凝固，身体也干瘪了些许。
那该死的老头也躺在原地，无人为其收尸，干枯的身体流出不多的血液。
小黑的孩子们不断的用嘴拱向她的身体，发出阵阵呜咽声。
仿佛想要将母亲唤醒，又仿佛在为她送别。
这一幕神识远比双眼感受的更为清晰。
茅不易回想起前日：
它在欣欣怀中，老头在喂着小黑，小黑身边是她的孩子，她的孩子摇着尾巴围在她身边。
顿时茅不易心中莫名烦躁起来，他试图劝说自己。
生老病死，自然规律罢了！
但小黑孩子发出的阵阵呜咽声，却让他体会到了从未有过的感受——伤心。
他缓缓飞向小黑，小黑的孩子嘤嘤的凑到他的身边。

毛茸茸的触感从身体传来，温暖且安心。
小黑经过他三年的喂养，已经可以算作灵兽。
虽然它已经死了，但其对蜣螂来说仍是不可多得的美食。
看着小黑，茅不易骨子中的虫族的本能让他将其吸收。
但他的心中悲伤让他生不起半点吸收的欲望。
看着死去的小黑，一股凄凉感遍布全身。
沉默片刻后，他用强壮的前肢挖出一个深深的大坑，随后将小黑推了下去，又转头看向老头。
心想到：你也一起吧，就当给小黑做伴了！
随后用土将二人掩埋。
此刻他虽是虫身，却生出了一颗人心。
茅不易用神识感受着高高立起的土堆。
“记忆中人族便是如此祭奠亡者的吧！”
随后他缓缓飞入木屋之中，神识掠过。
欣欣生活的痕迹在其脑中崭露无遗：
content_en:
"Human beings are really weird. They still care about others when they can't protect themselves!"
Although Mao Buyi was puzzled, he continued to dig deeper until he felt safe.
As night falls, Daze is still shrouded in white mist.
There was no moonlight or starlight, the whole land was dark, and nothing could be seen with the eyes.
A green dung beetle emerged from the soil.
"Well, they're all gone, so it's safe now!"
"Woof! Woof!"
Hearing the cry, Mao Buyi unfolded his consciousness:
Xiao Hei was still lying in a pool of blood like it was daytime.
But the blood around him had solidified, and his body was a little shriveled.
The damn old man was also lying there, with no one collecting his body, and not much blood was flowing out of his withered body.
Xiaohei's children kept pressing their mouths against her body, making bursts of whimpering sounds.
It seemed as if he wanted to wake up his mother, but also seemed to say goodbye to her.
The spiritual consciousness of this scene is far clearer than what the eyes can perceive.
Mao Buyi recalled the day before yesterday:
It was in Xinxin's arms, and the old man was feeding Xiao Hei. Next to Xiao Hei were her children, who were wagging their tails around her.
Suddenly Mao Buyi felt inexplicably irritated, and he tried to persuade himself.
Birth, old age, illness and death are just natural laws!
But the whimpering sounds made by the little black child made him feel something he had never felt before - sadness.
He slowly flew towards Xiao Hei, and Xiao Hei's child came to him with a loud voice.
The furry touch comes from the body, warm and reassuring.
After three years of feeding him, Xiao Hei can be regarded as a spiritual beast.
Although it is dead, it is still a rare delicacy for the dung beetle.
Looking at Xiao Hei, the Zerg instinct in Mao Buyi's bones made him absorb it.
But the sadness in his heart prevented him from having any desire to absorb it.
Looking at the dead Xiao Hei, a sense of desolation spread throughout his body.
After a moment of silence, he dug a deep hole with his strong forelimbs, then pushed Xiao Hei down, and then turned to look at the old man.
I thought: You can come along too, just be Xiao Hei’s companion!
Then they were buried with soil.
Although he was an insect at this moment, he had a human heart.
Mao Buyi felt the tall mound of soil with his spiritual consciousness.
"In my memory, this is how the human race pays homage to the dead!"
Then he slowly flew into the wooden house, and his consciousness passed by.
The traces of Xinxin’s life are clearly visible in his mind:
